header.scoring: Scores are percentiles within this universe (0 = lowest repo, 100 = highest; ties share the average rank), rounded to 0.1. Higher always means more of the criterion. Popularity: stars. Momentum: lifetime star velocity (stars_per_day) and forks created in the last 30 days (forks_30d), equally weighted (D13; star_events_30d is not used because the events feed caps it). Quality: a weighted mean of commits in the last 90 days capped at 150 (25%), distinct commit authors in the last 90 days capped at 4 (25%), number of releases capped at 40 (20%), recency of the last commit (20%), and has-a-real-README (10%: 100 if the README has at least 500 characters, 0 if shorter or missing, 50 if unknown). Each capped metric is clipped before its percentile, so every repo at or above the cap ties: volume beyond the cap earns nothing more, and README length beyond the threshold does not count. Newness: creation date, so the newest repo scores 100. A metric that is unknown (None) for a repo counts as the median (50) for that repo, neither rewarded nor penalised; the other repos' percentiles are computed among the known values only.
